procedure.anchor: V4 cal_interaction trained on screen fit (60000), V3 inner OOF features for fit/cal; same model as prior/prior/v4 component, not the full-fit report control
procedure.geometry: WGS84 Geod.inv/fwd in km; predictor-to-truth tangent offsets around V4 fit weights. Signed east/north error correlations use truth-to-prediction offsets for both models in a shared frame.
procedure.calibration: 20000 calibration rows partitioned into 4 deterministic shuffled blocks. Each calibration blend is scored out-of-fold with weights fitted on the other 3. Selection across OOF scores still tunes on this calibration sample.
procedure.weights: ridge 0.05 times component Gram diagonal; signed coefficients clipped to [-0.40, 0.65], positive singleton coefficients clipped to [0,0.65]; all weights refit on full calibration before evaluation
procedure.selection: All 300 ranked by measured exact WGS84 singleton gain over V4, separate positive and signed gains. Forward search, max four, accepts marginal gains >=0.05 km. At later steps all remaining candidates ranked by OOF tangent MSE; best 12 rescored by exact WGS84. Ties broken by name.
procedure.full_cv_routing: Post-lock resource routing: exclude previously retained family champions, take up to three additions, at most two absent from previous required cache. Include best positive-gain unseen candidate if greedy has none. If necessary route best eligible singleton explicitly as exploratory.
procedure.evaluation: Only after writing selection, evaluate selected and resource-routed specialists plus greedy blend on 12500 pre-existing screening validation rows. This partition was historically used for previous screen selection, and is not an untouched final test.
